description.text: Adds .vscode/ for VS Code: tasks for dotnet runic dev, debug configurations for the C# extension and the recommended extensions. Visual Studio and Rider use Properties/launchSettings.json, which every project has.

Creates a solution with this library project beside the application, such as Notes.Core: shared ViewModels and Views, and the frontend package that holds their TypeScript clients, in one JavaScript workspace. Not with Translations or the Nix flake yet.
